Commentary.Commentary: The Sri Lankan bowlers were once again not up to the mark as they kept leaking runs throughout. However, they did a really good job in the death overs, especially Perera, but the last over from Lakmal ruined it completely. Dananjaya was the best of the lot. Perera picked up three but went for runs as well. Pradeep, too, got two wickets but couldn't keep a check on the scoring rate. The pitch looks like a batting beauty and Sri Lanka should fancy their chances. Still, it will require a good display of batting if they are to open their account. Let's see how they fare this time around. Join us back shortly for the run chase...

19 runs off the final over means that Bangladesh end their innings on a high. They won a good toss and decided to have a bat. Their openers laid a solid foundation with a 71-run stand. Tamim, Shakib, Rahim all scored fifties and there were four 50-plus stands in their innings which saw them motoring along well. Sabbir Rahman, then, towards the end hit a few lusty blows to provide the perfect finishing touch.
FOUR! Strong finish from the hosts! In the zone for Rahman again. He backs away and flat-bats it over mid off to pick up another boundary. 19 from the last over. BANGLADESH FINISH ON 320/7.
SIX! In the arc, out of the park! Length ball on middle, allows Rahman to line it up. He clears his front leg and heaves it over long on for a mammoth maximum.

FOUR! Finds the fence again! On a length around off, Rahman makes room and goes inside out over extra cover. Chandimal gives it a long hard chase from mid off, slides and pulls the ball back in. The umpires check for it but the replays find that while trying to keep the ball in play, Chandimal's back leg was in contact with it and his boot was touching the ropes. Hence, a boundary is signaled.
Full ball outside off, Rahman drills it but straight to the man at covers.
Around the hips, Mohammad tries to turn it away but the ball brushes his pads and rolls behind. The batsmen sneak in a leg bye.
FOUR! Capitalizes on the loose delivery! Dishes out a full toss on middle, Saifuddin smashes it past the bowler for a boundary.
Another fine yorker, carved away towards third man for a run. What an over from Perera, a wicket and only 4 from it.
This is terrific bowling from Perera. Finds the blockhole again. Saifuddin keeps it out.
Pinpoint yorker, dug out past mid off for a single.
Played to the point region by the batsman. One run added to the total. 300 up for Bangladesh.
Mohammad Saifuddin is the next batsman.

OUT! Plumb! Another great review from Sri Lanka. Full and accurate, tailing in prodigiously. Hossain tries to keep it out but seems to have missed it to get hit on the front boot. The Sri Lankans roar in appeal but the umpire stays put. Perera challenges the decision. Time for the replays. There is no bat involved. Ball Tracker shows three reds. Another one goes down.
Perera feels that he has caught Hossain in front of the stumps. Signals for the review instantly. Is it boot first?
Slower delivery outside off, Rahman tries to sweep it but gets an outside edge to the off side. A run taken.
Nasir Hossain strides out to bat.

OUT! What a screamer of a catch from Dananjaya! Take a bow. Slower ball on a shortish length, Mortaza gives himself room and pulls it over square leg. Has connected well but Dananjaya runs to his left and plucks it out of thin air. Appeared from the shadows and pounced on it with confidence. His teammates are jubilant!
FOUR! Full toss outside off, Mortaza throws his bat at it and carves it over cover-point. Kusal Perera in the deep runs to his left, slides and tries to keep the ball in play but fails.
Guided down to fine leg by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
FOUR! Like an arrow takes off from the bow of the archer, this one took off at lightning pace. In the arc for Rahman. He smashes it over mid on for a rocketing boundary.

Almost another wicket! Short delivery at 111.6 clicks, Mortaza goes for the pull but fails to get hold of it. Ends up top edging it towards deep square leg but the ball goes on the bounce to the fielder.
Around the hips, tucked to fine leg for a run.
Hits the stumps but at the other end! Full ball on middle, Mortaza drills it but the ball crashes onto the stumps at the bowler's end. Deserved a boundary there.
Fullish ball, clipped through mid-wicket for a run.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Mashrafe Mortaza is the new man in. He will be aiming to finish with a flourish.

OUT! Bowled 'em! A ripper of a delivery to get rid of the wicket-keeper batsman. Full and fast, tailing in. Rahim clears his front leg and goes for an agricultural slog but misses the line completely to get his stumps shattered. Perera picks up his second wicket. Rahim can prove to be dangerous at the fag end. Sri Lanka will be happy to get rid of him.

FOUR! Tough luck, Dananjaya! Pitched up around off, Rahim makes room and crunches it past the diving fielder at covers. Dananjaya in the deep runs to his right, dives full length and pushes the ball in but is unfortunate as it rolls back to the ropes.
Right on the money! His squarish arm at the point of delivering the ball helps him to bowl good yorkers. Right in the blockhole, tailing in. Rahim jams it out towards mid off.
Thisara Perera is back on.
Sharp bouncer around off, Rahman sways away from it in a flash to evade it.
Shortish ball and slower in pace outside off, placed square of the wicket on the off side for a run.
Back of a length around off, dabbed to third man for a single.
Driven towards the mid off region. One run added to the total.
Slower ball outside off, Rahim throws his bat at it but misses.
Sabbir Rahman is the new man in.

OUT! Mahmudullah holes out against the run of play! Smart bowling from Pradeep to deceive the batsman. Bowls the leg cutter on middle and lands it on a good length, Mahmudullah uses his feet but is not quite to the pitch of the ball. Ends up miscuing it over mid on. Perera from the deep charges in, lines it up and takes a good catch. He has got a bucket like hands. End of a handy knock from the middle order batsman.
Flighted ball outside off, Mahmudullah taps it past cover-point for a run. Yet another 50-run stand, the fourth consecutive one of the innings. This has been a good display of batting from the hosts.

SIX! Going, going and gone! Tossed up delivery on middle, allows enough time for Mahmudullah to get underneath it. He chips down the track and tonks it to send it sailing into the long on stands. Meaty blow this!
Floated on off, Rahim slog sweeps it over mid-wicket to rotate strike.
Cheeky! Kneels down and paddle sweeps it over the keeper towards fine leg for a couple.
Very full ball around off, jammed out towards covers for a single.
Full ball on off, swept nicely to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Waits for this one and steers it towards third man for a single. 12 from the over.

28th ODI fifty for Rahim! He came in and kept on ticking the scoreboard from the word go. Capitalized on the loose deliveries and has played an enterprising knock so far. Sits back and pulls it behind square leg for a couple.

FOUR! Not convincing but good enough! Another slower ball, Rahim shuffles across and goes for the paddle scoop. Doesn't find the sweet spot of the bat but still manages to clear a leaping Dickwella to find the fence behind.
Slower ball outside off, much better from Pradeep. Dabbed to third man for a single.

FOUR! Terrific shot! Length delivery around off, Mahmudullah gives himself room and punches it on the up over the cover region. Got on top of the bounce and executed his inside out shot to perfection. Not the ideal length to be bowling at this stage.
Good length ball on middle and leg, Mahmudullah rises on his toes and works it with the angle to square leg.
Nuwan Pradeep returns for his final spell.
On a flatter trajectory, placed towards the point region for a single.
Straighter one this time, skidding after pitching. Mushfiqur tucks it through mid-wicket for a run.
Allows the ball to turn away and eases it to sweeper cover for a single.
Floated outside off, encouraging Mahmudullah to go for an ambitious stroke. He obliges but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
The batsman has driven it through mid on. One run added to the total.
Well played but fails to find the gap! Fullish ball around off, Rahim reverse sweeps it but finds the man at short third man.
Spinning down the leg side again, the batsman misses it to wear it on his pads. A good spell from Dananjaya comes to an end. His figures read - 10-0-40-1.
Covers the line to this one and keeps it out watchfully.
A chirpy appeal goes in vain! Tossed up on middle, spinning down. Mahmudullah tries to clip it but is hit on the pads. That was missing the leg stump.
Drifting towards the pads, helped to the leg side to rotate strike.
Turning in from outside leg, tucked against the spin in front of square leg for a run.
Fullish in line of the stumps, Rahim nudges it through square leg for a single.
Dananjaya is back on for his final over.
Floated outside off, stroked with the spin to sweeper cover for a run. Tidy stuff from Hasaranga, only 3 from the over.
In the air... but safe! Tossed up around off, Mahmudullah swings hard at it but ends up mistiming it over mid off. However, it lands well short of the man running in from the deep. A single results.
Slow through the air, defended solidly off the front foot.
Well bowled! In the blockhole around off, Mahmudullah is alert to it and digs it out.
Fullish delivery, eased against the spin to mid on.
Short delivery and room on offer, cut to the man at backward point.
Time for Powerplay 3! Five fielders are now allowed outside the 30-yard circle till the end of the innings. Meanwhile, Hasaranga is back on.
Spinning into Rahim who tucks it around the corner for a single and will retain the strike.
Full ball on off, swept nicely through square leg for a brace.
Hangs deep in the crease and works it to the leg side for a run.
Strides forward and turns it with the angle to square leg for a single.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Smartly bowled! Mahmudullah gives the charge and Gunaratne spots him. Bowls an off cutter on off. The all-rounder can only jam it down.

FOUR! Bangladesh keep on finding the boundaries! Some inaccurate bowling helping their cause as well. Short ball outside off, Rahim rises on his toes and upper cuts it over the point region to pick up a boundary.
Fullish delivery, shaping in, Rahim lunges forward in defense.
Hangs back and plays it uppishly to covers to rotate strike.
FOUR! Blazing way to get off the mark! Short and width on offer, Mahmudullah pounces on it and flays it past point to find the ropes.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Fuller in length, kept out watchfully.
Fuller in length, pushed on the up to the cover region. Brilliant over from Gunaratne, a wicket and only 3 from it.
Mahmudullah comes out to bat. 150th ODI for him. He will be eager to make it a memorable one.

OUT! The fifth bowling option has provided a vital breakthrough! Brilliant catch by him to see the back of the danger man, Shakib. The all-rounder makes room and Gunaratne follows him with a flatter delivery on a shorter length. Shakib tries to flat-bat it but only manages to hit it from the toe end of his bat. Gunaratne in his followthrough is alert and takes a very fine catch with his fingers pointing upwards. The visitors need to keep chipping away at the wickets.

A stifled appeal for a caught behind denied! Off cutter on off, Shakib backs away and tries to go inside out but misses it. Dickwella is again sharp as a hawk and collects it. Appeals but the umpire stays put. No bat involved there.
Another slower ball on middle and leg, pulled to the man at short fine leg for a brisk run.
Off cutter this time, turned around the corner for a run.
Hangs deep in the crease and works it to the leg side for a single.
Chandimal turns to his fifth bowler again. Gunaratne comes back for a bowl.
Good game awareness! Shortish delivery on leg stump, Shakib mistimes his pull towards fine leg. Some aggressive running allows them to take two. 10 from this over.

FOUR! A shot of a man who is high on confidence! Lakmal continues to hit the deck hard. It doesn't work in his favour. Shakib lines it up and dumps it over mid-wicket to find the fence. The partnership between the two crosses 50. It has come in quick time as well, just in 46 balls to be precise. Bangladesh will be aiming to tee off.
Full length ball on the pads, Rahim misses out on it. Clips it aerially towards fine leg for another run.
This is too easy at the moment for the home side! Good length ball down the leg side, turned sweetly to fine leg for another run.
Back of a length outside off, steered nicely to third man for an easy single.
Shortish ball in line of the stumps, the all-rounder hops and turns it around the corner to rotate strike.
Suranga Lakmal, one of Sri Lanka's strike bowlers, returns to have a crack at the batsmen.

Back of a length ball on leg stump, Shakib swipes it away towards deep square leg. The fielder in the deep overruns a bit but has the presence of mind to recover. Dives to his right to make a good stop. A single results.
Full ball outside off, stroked off the front foot to sweeper cover for a run.
Short ball, sitting up nicely for Rahim. Pulled hard to deep mid-wicket for a brace.
SIX! Downtown goes Rahim! The best shot is to hit there and he picks his spot to perfection. Skips down the track to the length ball and lifts it over the bowler for a biggie.
Back of a length ball outside off, angling in, Rahim is cramped for room and chops it to point.
Shoddy from Sri Lanka! On a length on middle, turned through mid-wicket for a run. Lakmal who is chasing it is lazy and fumbles. Concedes another run.
Fullish delivery, driven with the spin to long of for a single.
The batsman has pushed it to the cover region. They pick up a single.
Shorter in length on middle and off, skids off after pitching. Shakib is hurried a bit as he tries to manufacture a shot through the off side but mistimes it down the track.
Outside off, cut against the spin through point for a run.
FOUR! Hit with disdain! Slow through the air around off, Shakib extends his arms and whacks it past mid off for a rocketing boundary. He is oozing with confidence at the moment.
Loopy delivery on middle, turned with the angle to mid-wicket.
Landed it full outside off, caressed off the front foot to covers.
Full ball outside off, carved away to the point region.

So much risk involved in that! Might have cost his side a lot. Anyway, Shakib reaches his 36th ODI fifty and has played a good hand for his side, his first half century at No. 3. Fuller length ball on off, Shakib drives it on the up towards mid off and sets off. The fielder aims at the bowler's end as Shakib dives to make his crease but misses his target. A direct hit would have made things interesting. The all-rounder raises his bat towards the crowed and gets a huge round of applause. He was the Man of the Match in the previous game and is looking in good shape again.
Full length ball on off, Shakib comes forward and defends it with a high elbow.
A well-disguised slower ball on middle. It's the off cutter and it grips after pitching. Shakib plays it with the angle to the point region.
Fractionally overpitched outside off, Rahim leans into it and creams it to sweeper cover for a run.

Time for drinks. Meanwhile, there is a bowling change. Perera is back into the attack. Chandimal is having a chat with him. The visitors need to find a way to stem the run-flow. Picking up wickets is the best way to do that or else Bangladesh will keep on dominating the proceedings.

FOUR! Poor delivery and duly punished! Half tracker on leg stump, asking to be hit. Shakib obliges and pulls it with authority over square leg. The fielder in the deep hares across to his right but only comes second best. 11 from the over, Bangladesh are motoring along nicely.
Floated delivery, Rahim leans ahead and taps it to mid on for a brisk single.
Slow through the air outside off, Mushfiqur plays it with an open bat face past the point region to pick up a brace.
FOUR! Nicely done! Slips in the wrong one again, this time Rahim reads it well. Rocks back and cuts it past the diving backward point fielder to pick up a boundary.
Fullish ball, eased off the front foot to mid off.

That's a beautiful delivery! Slips in the wrong one, Rahim fails to read it as he attempts a dab down to third man. The ball turns in, beats Rahim and just misses the off pole. Good take from Dickwella.
In the line of the stumps, the all-rounder hangs deep in the crease and tucks it to mid-wicket.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. They pick up a single.
Tossed up ball, driven back to the bowler who makes a good stop.
On a flatter trajectory around middle, played with a closed bat face to mid-wicket for a single.
The batsman has driven it straight down the ground.
Flatter on middle and leg, tucked to deep square leg for a single.
Slow through the air, knocked down to long on for a single.
Quicker down the leg side, tickled past the keeper towards fine leg. Three runs taken.

Almost another wicket! It is all happening in Mirpur. Tossed up outside off, Rahim goes for the big sweep but gets a top edge. Luckily for him, the ball lobs over the slip fielder and falls down safely. A run taken.
Leans ahead confidently and eases it through mid off for a single.
Hangs back to this one and blocks it to the off side.
Fullish ball, eased through covers for a single.
Short ball outside off, cut with the spin to point. Great over from Dananjaya.
Similar ball, kept out watchfully.
Tossed up ball, defended solidly off the front foot.
Hangs back and punches this one out.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. They pick up a single.
Mushfiqur Rahim strides out to bat.

OUT! A judicious use of the review! The entire credit must go to Dickwella. Dananjaya gets the big fish! Bowls this one slow through the air around off and gets it to spin away. Iqbal tries to defend it but fails to do so properly. Dickwella takes it sharply behind and also flicks the bails off. He walks down the track and instantly signals for the 'T'. The skipper has the right though to do that. Chandimal permits the usage of the DRS. Time for the replays. They check for the stumping first (strangely). Well, the opener's back foot is grounded. The main question is whether there is an edge or not. The Snicko rolls in and it spots a definite deflection. OUT flashes on the giant screen and the Sri Lankans are relieved. End of a brilliant knock and also the 99-run stand. Can the visitors capitalize on this?

Sri Lanka feel that they have got their man! This can be a real crucial breakthrough for them. Dickwella is confident that Iqbal has got an outside edge behind. He doesn't even turn to his captain and signals for the review immediately. Let's find out.
On the pads, clipped to the leg side for a run.
Short ball on middle, pulled all along the ground to deep square leg for a run.
Driven through mid on by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Fullish in length outside off and slow through the air as well, ample time for Shakib to ease it to sweeper cover for a run.
Floated in line of the stumps, turned through mid-wicket for a single.
Fractionally short outside off, cut against the spin through point for a single.
Wanindu Hasaranga comes into the attack. The Sri Lankan players are in a huddle at the moment. Time to regroup. They can't allow the game to run away from them.
Tossed up around off, Shakib takes a stride forward and milks it down to long off for a run. Tidy over from Dananjaya, only 2 from it.
Slow through the air, defended solidly off the front foot.
Stays leg side of the delivery and caresses it through covers for a single.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman.
Fullish in length, patted to the mid off region.
Floated ball, eased back towards the bowler.
FOUR! Smashed! Continues to hit the deck hard, Shakib Al Hasan stands his ground and pulls it with authority through mid-wicket for back-to-back boundaries.

FOUR! Dismissed from its presence! The short ball ploy is not working at all. Agreed that it brought in a wicket but it is sitting up nicely at the moment for the batsmen. On middle this time, Shakib nails the pull through mid-wicket to find the fence.
Awkwardly played! Another short ball on middle, Iqbal unlike his partner takes his eyes off the ball. Manages to pull it somehow to the same region for a single.
Short ball on middle and leg, doesn't rise much. Ample time for Shakib to pull it to deep square leg to rotate strike.
Similar delivery, Iqbal plays this one with a closed bat face towards mid on for a brisk run.
Fullish delivery, attacking the stumps, milked down to long on for a single.

Fullish ball in line of the stumps, patted to the right side of the bowler. Good comeback from Dananjaya after being hit for a boundary on the first ball. Iqbal has scored 28 off his last 20 balls after reaching his fifty. Clear signs of him shifting gears.
Floated in line of the stumps, Iqbal lunges forward in defense.
Driven towards the mid off region.
On a flatter trajectory, knocked down to long on for a single.
Helps this one with the angle to the leg side for a single.

FOUR! Runs are coming thick and fast at the moment! Doesn't allow the spinner to get any sort of rhythm. Floated outside off, Iqbal carves it over the point region and pierces the two men in the deep to perfection. Picks up another boundary.
Dananjaya returns for a bowl.
Around the hips this time, nudged around the corner for a single.
On a length, tucked to mid-wicket to rotate strike.

Another nervy moment! Pounded hard on the deck, Iqbal takes on the pull but ends up top edging it towards deep backward square leg. There are two men near the ropes. Dananjaya judges it well and dives to his right to stop a few runs for his side. Only a run taken.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.

FOUR! Poetry in motion! Sweetly timed. Fractionally overpitched outside off, Iqbal leans ahead and creams it through covers for a glorious boundary. No chance for the man in the deep to cut that one off.
Dug in shot, Iqbal sways away from the line of the delivery to evade it.

In the air... but safe! Drifting in towards the pads, Tamim kneels to slog sweep it but ends up top edging it. The ball lands well short of the deep backward square leg fielder. A run taken. 15 from the over.

SIX! They are targeting the 5th bowler and it is coming off! Iqbal is shifting gears with ease. Similar delivery on middle, the opener stays leg side of the ball, gets his dancing shoes on and tonks it over long on for back-to-back maximums. That went flat as an arrow.

SIX! Clean as a whistle! Tossed up ball on middle, Iqbal is nimble on his feet and smokes it down the ground to send it sailing over the sightscreen. That came off the meat of the bat, no half measures there.
Fuller in length, eased off the front foot to extra cover.
Well played! Slow through the air outside off on a fullish length, Iqbal waits for it and dabs it deftly past the keeper. Perera hares after it and keeps the batsmen down to a couple.
Fuller in length around off, Iqbal covers the line and pushes it past the bowler towards mid off.
Tight stump-to-stump line, kept out watchfully.
Wide! Goes for a bouncer and it shoots off the deck. Shakib Al Hasan shapes for the pull but it is too high to attempt it. Wide signaled for height.

Fullish delivery outside off, Tamim makes room, steps out of the crease and caresses it through covers for a run. That brings up the 50-run stand between the duo. Back-to-back for these two, continuing from where they left off.
Hangs back to the length ball and defends it down the track.
Well bowled! Pradeep bowls this one on a fuller length around off, Iqbal is opened up in his stance but manages to block it besides the pitch on the off side.
Length delivery around middle and leg, hits the bat hard again as the all-rounder works it through square leg to rotate strike.
Starts off with a shortish ball on off, Shakib hops and fends it off towards the point region.
Nuwan Pradeep comes back into the attack.
Lands it full on off, Shakib drives it down to long off for a single to end the over.
Length ball just outside off, defended towards the point fielder.
On the pads, nudged towards the man at 45 for a single.
The batsman has driven it through mid on. They pick up a single.
Floated ball on the stumps, blocked defended into the ground.

There it is! 40th ODI fifty for Tamim Iqbal! Back-to-back in this series. Looks set for a big one today as well! Flighted delivery around middle and leg, eased down to long on for a single. It's been a slow knock from him so far but we all know he can pick up the scoring rate later on.
Back of a length delivery on middle and leg, defended off the back foot.
Wide! Hits the deck hard, gets it to bounce too much off the surface. Shakib just lets it be.
FOUR! Off the middle! Short of a length delivery on middle and leg, Shakib swivels inside the crease and pulls it with aplomb through backward square leg. It whistles away to the fence.
Pitched up on off, driven towards the man at mid off.
Strays on the pads, clipped through mid-wicket for a single.
Low full toss on the leg stump, Tamim Iqbal looks to flick it away but gets a soft leading edge towards the cover fielder.
Wide! Slower one down the leg side, Tamim misses his flick. The ball goes agonizingly past the leg pole.
Short ball outside off, pulled towards deep mid-wicket for a single.

Good stop! Drops it short and outside off, Shakib slaps it square of the wicket on the off side. Seemed like it will run away for a boundary but the man from sweeper cover, covers good ground to stop a run for his side.
It's been driven superbly through the covers. One run added to the total.
Taps it in front of cover-point and calls through for a brisk single.
Drives again but finds the man at mid off.
Tossed up on off, driven towards sweeper cover for one.

FOUR! Sloppy from Lakmal! Asela starts off with a length delivery outside off, Tamim crouches low and dabs it past short third man. Suranga goes after it and dives midway to stop but the ball still wins the race. 100 up for Bangladesh.
Asela Gunaratne comes on to bowl.

Is that off the bat? Nopes! Perera with another well-directed short ball, Shakib winds up for the pull but seems to have missed it. Cops a blow on the helmet as the ball lobs up again. Perera in his followthrough runs in to catch it but fails to reach.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. They pick up a single.

FOUR! That's some response from Tamim! Anticipates the short ball and with both his legs in the air, he pummels it through mid-wicket. Asela comes across to his right, puts in a dive but lets it through to the fence.
Flush on the helmet! Bangs in a short one on middle, Tamim looks to pull but takes his eyes off the ball. Gets smashed on the helmet as the ball lobs up towards the keeper.
Another full length delivery outside off, Shakib eases it through covers for a single.
Fuller in length and outside off, driven through covers for a brace.
Wide! On the sixth stump line, Shakib still slashes at it and gets beaten. There is absolutely no need to go after it Shakib.
Loopy delivery on off, Iqbal prods forward to keep it out.
Bunted back to the bowler.
Shimmies down the track and drives it down to mid off for a single.
Loopy delivery outside off, swept through backward square leg for a single.
Takes a stride ahead and buries it into the ground.
Floated ball on off, dabbed with an angled bat to short third man for a single.
Gets across and helps this length ball down to fine leg for a single to retain strike.

FOUR! A boundary but not the way he would have liked! Length ball on off, Shakib looks to drive it away but his bottom hand comes off. Still he manages to get it down the ground past mid on for a boundary.
Shortish in length and outside off, Shakib steers it towards backward point.
Slightly short on middle, pulled through square leg for a single. Played it along the ground.
Fuller ball outside off, driven in the gap at cover for a single.
Back of a length delivery outside off, dabbed down to third man for a single.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Wide! Fires one down the leg side, Tamim gets down to sweep but misses to put bat on ball.
Loopy delivery outside off, Iqbal prods forward in defense.
Whipped away towards mid-wicket for one.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Gets forward and defends it down on the track.
Drops it short and serves it outside off, Tamim cuts it through backward point for a couple.
Skids off the pitch and pings Shakib on the thigh pad who looks to pull this one away. 3 runs and a wicket off it.
Shakib Al Hasan is in at no. 3.

OUT! Anamul Haque runs out of luck, finally! He was giving too many chances and finally Sri Lanka take one! What a take from Dickwella, absolutely stunning! Thisara Perera is delighted as he draws first blood! Bowls it short down the leg side, Haque looks to pull it away but there is a bit of extra bounce which takes the gloves. Niroshan moves quickly across to his left and times his leap to perfection to take a superb catch. Anamul departs after giving a good start.
Shortish on middle, helped towards deep backward square leg for a single.

In the air... Anamul gets lucky again! Goodness me, he continues to survive! Dances down to a length ball and mistimes it high in the air towards long off. Chandimal from mid off runs back, keeps his eyes on the ball and then dives full length by stretching both his hands but fails to reach. Another single taken.
Comes down the track to a length ball and tucks it wide of the man at mid-wicket for a single.
Shortish delivery, close to the off stump line, Tamim Iqbal looks to run it down but gets a bottom edge past the off stump to the keeper.
The ball strikes the batsman very low on the pads
Flatter one around middle and leg, blocked out.
Eases it through the cover region for a single.
The batsman gets to the pitch of the ball and connects. They pick up a single.
looks to play the reverse sweep but misses and is hit on the pads.

FOUR! Whipped away! Picks the wrong one early, clears the front leg and hits it over mid-wicket for a boundary to start the over. 1000 ODI runs for Anamul, becomes the joint fastest to reach this mark for a Bangladesh batsman, in 29 innings along with Shahriar Nafees.

In the air... safe! Anamul Haque gets lucky again! Short ball and it keeps climbing off the deck, Haque goes for the pull but is in no position to play the pull. Gets a big fat top edge which goes towards fine leg. The man from that region comes in while Dickwella runs backwards. The ball lands between them. A single picked up.
Shortish and outside off, too close to cut. Tamim chops it towards backward point for a single.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket. One run added to the total.
Rocks back to a back of a length and slaps it past a diving backward point fielder for one.
FOUR! Whipped away! Steps out to this length delivery and whips it away to leave the man at mid on stranded. A boundary results!

A huge shout for an LBW straightaway! Bowls a length delivery on the stumps, it skids off the deck to ping Tamim on the pads and beat his attempted flick shot. Thisara appeals but nothing from the umpire. Pitching outside leg, a good call from the umpire!
Thisara Perera into the attack now. He had a good run in the first game. Can he emulate the same? A slip in place...
Slider around leg, Anamul misses his flick as the ball goes off the pads towards Dickwella who fails to gather it cleanly.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Good bowling, this! Akila isn't afraid to toss the ball up. He does so again, Tamim dances down the track to go over covers but gets it off the toe end of the bat over the bowler for a single.
Slower through the air around off, it's bunted back to the bowler.
Darts it on the stumps, jammed out to mid on.
Floats it up around middle and leg, worked off the front foot to the square leg fielder.
Drifting in on the pads, Iqbal flicks it through backward square leg for a single.
The batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump. It was in fact an off cutter and it rolled on the bounce to the keeper.
Wide! Another delivery on the shorter length, Iqbal half ducks under it.
Driven crisply only to find the man at cover.
Short and kicking off the surface, Tamim is late to sway away from the line and wears it on the chest.
Wrists this fuller ball through square leg for a single.
Steers this length delivery towards the point fielder.
Powerplay 2 has been signalled. Some comfort for the fielding side as 4 men are now allowed outside the 30-yard circle till the 40th over.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman.
Wide! Fires it down the leg side, left alone. 50 up for Bangladesh!
Flicked through mid-wicket for a single.

STUMPING CHANCE MISSED! Haque is living a charmed life! Survived a scare in the very first over when he was dropped, then escaped a run out chance and now a stumping. Lady luck with him? Dananjaya slows it through the air, lands it on off and it stays a touch low as well. Haque walks down the track to clip it away but is undone by the low bounce as the ball sneaks under his bat. Dickwella behind the stumps fails to gather and the ball races down to the fine leg fence for a boundary. Four byes.
SIX! That's gone the distance! Akila loops it up outside off, Anamul Haque gets down and across on one knee and murders the slog sweep over deep backward square leg for a biggie.
Works it with the spin towards mid-wicket.
Tossed up ball outside off, a bit too full, Tamim squeezes it out to mid off for a single.
Akila Dananjaya is brought into the attack.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.

Direct hit and things would have been interesting! Tamim taps this length delivery towards backward point and calls his partner through. Haque responds and runs in at the danger end. The fielder has a shy but misses. Had that hit, it would have been really close. For now, a single is added to the total. The replays show that Anamul would have been out. Sri Lanka are letting good chances slip.
Lucky to get away this time, Lakmal! Errs in line and strays on the pads, Iqbal moves across to work it away but misses as the ball brushes the pads and rolls away towards square leg.
Lakmal bends his back and bangs in a short ball on leg, Tamim sits under the bumper.
Ahead of a length on middle and leg, flicked nicely but straight to the man at mid-wicket this time.
Angling away on a length outside off, tucked away towards the man at square leg.
Hops back and shows a straight bat in defense.
Gets far too across and tries to pull but misses to get hit on the thigh pad.
Good batting! Drags his length back a touch, angling in, it's worked in front of mid on for a quick single.

FOUR! Glorious! Pradeep goes wider of the crease and hurls it very full outside off. Tamim thinks this as an opportunity to score. Nicely leans ahead and drives it along the carpet through extra cover. No stopping that!
A well-directed short ball, Tamim is quick to take evasive action. He ducks and Dickwella does well to collect it with a leap.
Fuller in length and attacking the stumps, driven down the ground but sans any timing. The man from mid on gets across to his left to keep them down to one.
A little bit of width on offer outside off, Haque runs it down to third man and keeps strike for the next over.
Full and outside off, Anamul goes hard at it but gets an inside edge onto the pads. He is not looking comfortable.

EDGY FOUR! Anamul is living dangerously. There isn't a lot of sideways movement on offer and this one too holds its line after landing on a length. Since it's bowled around off, the batsman had to play at it. Anamul brings a straight bat to block but it takes the outside edge and flies past the lone slip fielder for a boundary.
This time Suranga Lakmal loses his run-up and pulls out of his delivery stride. He smiles as he returns.
Another quick single. This time Tamim bunts a full ball to mid off and scampers across to the other end. The fielder misses his shy at the non-striker's end.
Good length ball on middle and leg, Anamul works it in front of square leg and takes a run.
A length ball around middle and off, shaping back in, Tamim pushes it with gentle hands to mid on and pinches a single.

Suranga Lakmal steams in but Tamim Iqbal pulls out at the last moment. The pacers don't like it usually. But Lakmal is a gentleman, accepts the apology by Tamim and returns to his bowling mark. Maybe, there was some disturbance near the sightscreen.
Very full on the pads, clipped through backward square leg to keep strike.
Pushes it off the front foot towards the fielder at mid on.
Good length ball on off, Iqbal strides forward to drive but there is some zip off the surface which hits the top portion of the bat and lobs towards covers. Luckily, it falls safely.
On the hips, tucked uppishly behind square on the leg side for a double.
Gets on the front foot and pats it past the cover fielder for a single.
Jags back in from around middle and off, Anamul once again ekes out an inside edge on the pads. Saw a few already from him today.
Pounds in a short ball, gets some good bounce as Iqbal sits under it.
Tucks this length delivery on the pads towards square leg.
Marginally fuller, angling in on middle and leg, nudged with soft hands towards mid on for a single.
Good shot for nothing! Very full in length and outside off, driven hard but found the man at covers.
Another inside edge! Just ahead of a length around off, this one holds its line. Anamul presses forward to push it away but gets an inside edge on the pads again as the ball rolls towards cover.
Hits it on a length and it jags back in from outside off, Haque prods forward to tap it away but gets an inside edge on the back pad.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Tamim defends this length ball off the outer half of the bat towards the point fielder.
Bangs in a short delivery, down the leg side, Tamim is quick to duck under it.
That stayed a bit low! Good length ball, doesn't rise much, Iqbal does well to crouch and keep it out.
Angling away, it's on a back of a length, Tamim has no qualms in leaving that one alone.
Drops it on a length and it nips back in a shade, Anamul looks to offer a back foot defense but gets a thin inside edge which dribbles down towards the fine leg fence for a single.
Good length delivery on middle and leg, tucked towards the man at catching mid-wicket.
Taps this short of a length ball in front of point. Tamim wants a single but won't get it.
On middle and leg, worked with soft hands towards the leg side.
Hurls it away on a fuller length, Tamim prods forward and blocks it out towards cover.
Another full delivery, wristed wide of the man at mid on for a single.

FOUR! Delightful! We saw Tamim hitting one in the previous over, this time it's Haque! Fuller in length, angling in on middle, Anamul with a lunge forward, caresses it down the ground. Mid on had no chance to cut that one off.
Fires in a perfect yorker at the base of the stumps, Tamim once again falls over but does well to keep it at bay.
Angles it away on a back of a length, Iqbal gingerly pokes at it only to get beaten. Good bounce on that occasion.

FOUR! Beautiful shot! Pradeep in search of swing, delivers it really full on off. Tamim takes a stride forward and presents the full face of the bat. Makes connection off the sweet spot to beat the man at mid off. The fielder gives it a chase but couldn't stop it from crossing the fence. It's a milestone for Tamim - 11K international runs for him.
Good length delivery, angling back in on middle, wristed in front of square on the leg side for a couple.
Gets forward and drives it straight to the extra cover fielder.
Pradeep begins with a back of a length ball outside off, Haque stands tall and just uses the pace on the ball. Dabs it wide of the man at backward point and scampers through for a single.
Nuwan Pradeep to bowl with the second new ball from the other end.
Stands behind the line and offers a straight blade in defense. A tidy first over from Lakmal, unlucky not to have a wicket.
On a length and outside off, Tamim lifts his bat to make an assured leave.
There you go! Tempting lines from Lakmal! In the corridor of uncertainty, Tamim without any foot movement looks to drive but the ball shapes away a touch to nearly beat the outside edge.

Edged and dropped! Kusal Mendis is the man! My colleague reminds me that he dropped a couple of catches in the game against Zimbabwe too. Lakmal serves it full outside off, gets it to shape away further. Anamul Haque goes chasing after it and nearly pays the price. Gets a thick edge which flies towards Mendis at second slip who fails to hold on. The ball lobs up and Perera at first slip then tries to turn back to take it but can't reach to it. They take a single.
Fuller in length but it's a bit too straight from Lakmal, Haque flicks it through mid-wicket. It's in the gap and they take a brace.

Lovely delivery first up! A yorker, tailing back in on middle and leg, Tamim brings his bat down in time to dig it out but does so off the inner half to fine leg. The southpaw nearly falls over while bringing his bat down. Bangladesh are away.
We are all set to get underway. The Bangladesh openers are Tamim Iqbal and Anamul Haque. Sri Lanka to begin with Suranga Lakmal first up. Here we go...

PITCH REPORT - Athar Ali Khan says it's a new wicket. Looks like it's pretty compact and a good wicket to bat on. Adds the ball will come onto bat nicely but feels under lights the batsmen might find it a bit difficult.

TEAM NEWS - Two changes for Sri Lanka, Angelo Mathews (forced) and Dushmantha Chameera make way for NUWAN PRADEEP and NIROSHAN DICKWELLA. Bangladesh have brought in MOHAMMAD SAIFUDDIN for Sunzamul Islam.

Sri Lanka skipper, Dinesh Chandimal starts by saying it's unfortunate to lose Mathews who is out due to an injury. Opines they had a few discussions on how to win games. Further adds they played some good cricket in their first game and hopes for a good show today.

Bangladesh skipper, Mashrafe Mortaza says they will bat first. Adds they batted well in the first game and hence the decision. States it would be a different task against Sri Lanka as they are a much difficult side.
TOSS - Bangladesh win the toss and opt to bat!

The hosts are a much-balanced side as compared to Zimbabwe and it will require a huge effort on Sri Lanka's part to compete against them. Will Bangladesh continue with the winning momentum or will Sri Lanka open their account? Stay tuned as the toss report is coming up in a bit.

Welcome to match 3 of the tri-nation series between Bangladesh and Sri Lanka. The hosts marched their way to a comprehensive win against Zimbabwe in the opening fixture while it has gone all downhill for Sri Lanka as they lost a thriller against the African nation. It means that they come into this game with a lot of pressure and to add to it, they will be without their regular skipper, Angelo Mathews who has coped a blow on his hamstring.
